lines.cap: This dog can go all night, and never get tired.
lines.say: This dog can go all night, and never get tired.

lines.cap: The Iditarod. About a thousand miles across Alaska, in snow and darkness.
lines.say: The Iditarod. About a thousand miles across Alaska, in snow and darkness.

lines.cap: Sled dogs run up to a hundred miles a day, for days in a row.
lines.say: Sled dogs run up to a hundred miles a day, for days in a row.

lines.cap: For an athlete, that should mean running out of fuel, and crashing.
lines.say: For an athlete, that should mean running out of fuel, and crashing.

lines.cap: But scientists found something strange. After the first days, these dogs switch the way their bodies burn energy.
lines.say: But scientists found something strange. After the first days, these dogs switch the way their bodies burn energy.

lines.cap: Their muscles stop draining their own fuel stores, and run mostly on fat from their food. Like a car that refuels while it drives.
lines.say: Their muscles stop draining their own fuel stores, and run mostly on fat from their food. Like a car that refuels while it drives.

lines.cap: That's why they eat up to ten thousand calories a day during a race.
lines.say: That's why they eat up to ten thousand calories a day during a race.

lines.cap: So yes. He really can go all night. And all day. For a week.
lines.say: So yes. He really can go all night. And all day. For a week.
